title: Grab And Move should work with TouchScreen & Stylus
author: JimR-15

judgment.rationale: The report requests new touchscreen and stylus support for Grab and Move and does not identify a version in which those input paths worked; this is an enhancement, not a demonstrated bug.
evidence: The reporter asks for Win+touchscreen and Win+stylus dragging to work like the existing modifier-plus-mouse interaction.
The expected behavior explicitly adds touchscreen, touchpad, mouse, and stylus support.
No regression boundary, diagnostic, comment, assignee, or linked implementation is present.
Current GrabAndMove code handles low-level mouse messages and has no existing touch/stylus path.
judgment.recommended_action: Route as a feature request for product and interaction design rather than inventing a bug-fix plan.

fix_assessment.rationale: No PowerToys bug fix is applicable: the requested touch and pen input modalities are not shown to have been previously supported and require new gesture/input design.

issue_context.summary: The reporter wants Grab and Move's modifier-drag behavior extended to touchscreen and stylus input; current evidence describes missing functionality rather than a regression.
known_information: The scenario is a Framework 12 convertible laptop with touchscreen and stylus.
Modifier-plus-mouse dragging works, while touch and stylus dragging do nothing.
The issue gives no previously working version or regression boundary.
The issue has no comments, attachments, assignee, or linked work.
inferences: Adding touch and pen support would require new pointer handling and gesture semantics.
Touch scrolling, selection, pen behavior, pointer capture, and accessibility conflicts must be designed before implementation.
issue_context.analysis: The source confirms GrabAndMove's current interaction is built around low-level mouse hook messages. Without evidence that touch or pen was supported before, classifying the request as a bug would produce a fabricated root cause.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue body, labels, timeline state, and absence of linked work.
Inspected src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp; the activation path handles WM_LBUTTONDOWN, WM_MOUSEMOVE, and WM_LBUTTONUP.
Reviewed recent GrabAndMove history, which concerns mouse drag state, replay, resizing, and snapping rather than touch or pen support.

actions.label: Post feature-request guidance

comment.body: Thanks for the suggestion. Touchscreen and stylus support would add new input modalities to Grab and Move rather than fix a demonstrated regression in its current mouse interaction. This should be evaluated as a feature request, including the intended touch/pen gesture, interaction with normal scrolling and selection, and accessibility requirements.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted.
